_comment: DO NOT EDIT: Import this file in your Pterodactyl panel under Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: wolfXtg Telegram Bot
author: wolfXtg
description: Telegram automation bot with group management, media downloads, WhatsApp pairing, and more. Token is read from the .env file written during installation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl git

# Install pnpm
curl -fsSL https://get.pnpm.io/install.sh | bash -
export PNPM_HOME="/root/.local/share/pnpm"
export PATH="$PNPM_HOME:$PATH"

cd /mnt/server

# Clone or update repo
if [ -d .git ]; then
  echo "==> Updating existing installation..."
  git pull
else
  echo "==> Cloning repository..."
  git clone "${GIT_REPO}" .
fi

# Install dependencies
pnpm install --filter @workspace/telegram-bot --prod
mkdir -p bot/data

# Write token to .env — bot reads from this file at startup
echo "# wolfXtg Bot — auto-generated by Pterodactyl" > .env
echo "TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}" >> .env

echo "==> Installation complete. Token saved to .env"

variables.name: Bot Token
variables.description: Your Telegram bot token from @BotFather. This is saved to .env and read by the bot at every startup.

variables.name: Startup File
variables.description: Main entry file for the bot. Do not change this.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: The GitHub repository URL to clone during installation.
